title: Wan2.7-Video — Director-Grade Video Generation and Editing Suite
summary: A comprehensive video generation framework from Alibaba Cloud featuring 1080p text-to-video, image-to-video with transition control, and natural language instruction editing. It utilizes a 'Thinking Mode' for enhanced logical coherence and physical accuracy.
research_notes: Released with open weights under Apache 2.0. Key innovations include character consistency via multi-reference inputs and a 'First-and-Last-Frame' mode for precise motion transitions.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the open-source Wan2.1 series (2025), adding native 1080p support, instruction-based editing, and a planning layer to reduce hallucinations. It expanded from simple generation to full narrative control.
